entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date you arrive.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de vencimiento al menos 6 meses posterior a la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: To enter Equatorial Guinea, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: You must have a visa to visit, and short-term visas are valid for 90 days.
entry.es: Se necesita visado para visitar el país, y los visados de corta duración son válidos por 90 días.
entry.quote: You must have a visa to visit Equatorial Guinea. Short-term visas are valid for 90 days.

entry.en: You complete an online visa form, which takes 72 hours to process, and present the printed e-visa letter on arrival.
entry.es: Se rellena el formulario de visado en línea, que tarda 72 horas en tramitarse, y se presenta la carta de e-visa impresa a la llegada.
entry.quote: Complete the online visa application form and upload the required documents. The processing time is 72 hours. Print out the e-visa letter to present on arrival, and border officials will issue your visa.

entry.en: Travellers have reported delays or threats of detention when their passports were not properly processed.
entry.es: Algunos viajeros han informado de retrasos o amenazas de detención cuando sus pasaportes no se tramitaron correctamente.
entry.quote: Travellers have reported being delayed or threatened with detention because their passports have not been properly processed.

entry.en: A certificate proving yellow fever vaccination is required because of the risk of yellow fever transmission.
entry.es: Se exige un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla debido al riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: You must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination, due to a risk of yellow fever transmission.

entry.en: E-visas are available to all nationalities, cost US$75, take 72 hours and are only valid for entry by air at Malabo airport.
entry.es: Los e-visados están disponibles para todas las nacionalidades, cuestan 75 USD, tardan 72 horas y solo valen para entrar por aire en el aeropuerto de Malabo.
entry.quote: e-Visas are available to all nationalities, cost US$75 and are processed in 72 hours. However, they are only valid for entry by air at Malabo airport.

safety.en: Crime ranges from petty theft to armed robbery, and risks can be greater in remote parts of towns after dark, including around Malabo and Bata.
safety.es: Los delitos van del hurto menor al robo armado, y el riesgo puede ser mayor en zonas remotas de las ciudades tras el anochecer, incluidas Malabo y Bata.
safety.quote: Crimes range from petty theft and mugging to carjacking and armed robbery, risks can be greater in remote areas of towns, particularly after dark including around Malabo and Bata.

safety.en: There have been reports of robberies and violent assaults on taxi passengers in Malabo and Bata, particularly at night.
safety.es: Se han notificado robos y agresiones violentas a pasajeros de taxis en Malabo y Bata, sobre todo de noche.
safety.quote: There have been reports of robberies and violent assaults on passengers travelling by taxi in Malabo and Bata, particularly at night.

safety.en: Travellers should avoid political rallies, demonstrations and large public gatherings.
safety.es: Se aconseja evitar mítines políticos, manifestaciones y grandes concentraciones públicas.
safety.quote: Avoid any political rallies, demonstrations or large public gatherings.

safety.en: Photographing government or military buildings or airports is illegal and can lead to arrest and detention.
safety.es: Fotografiar edificios gubernamentales o militares o aeropuertos es ilegal y puede acarrear arresto y detención.
safety.quote: Photographing government or military buildings or airports is illegal and you could be arrested and detained.

safety.en: Police and security forces at roadblocks regularly ask for bribes.
safety.es: La policía y las fuerzas de seguridad piden sobornos con regularidad en los controles de carretera.
safety.quote: There are regular reports of police and uniformed security forces at roadblocks asking for bribes.

safety.en: Same-sex relationships are not illegal, but there is no legal protection against discrimination based on sexual orientation.
safety.es: Las relaciones entre personas del mismo sexo no son ilegales, pero no hay protección legal contra la discriminación por orientación sexual.
safety.quote: Same-sex relationships are not illegal in Equatorial Guinea, but there is no legal protection against discrimination based on sexual orientation.

health.en: Medical facilities are generally poor, apart from the La Paz hospital in Malabo.
health.es: Las instalaciones médicas son en general deficientes, salvo el hospital La Paz de Malabo.
health.quote: Medical facilities are generally poor, apart from the La Paz hospital in Malabo. Emergency facilities are extremely limited.

health.en: For serious medical treatment evacuation to Europe is likely, so adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds are needed.
health.es: Para un tratamiento médico grave es probable la evacuación a Europa, por lo que hacen falta un seguro de salud de viaje adecuado y fondos accesibles.
health.quote: For serious medical treatment, evacuation to Europe is likely. Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment abroad and repatriation.

health.en: There are no potable or clean water sources, so visitors should drink only bottled water.
health.es: No hay fuentes de agua potable ni limpia, por lo que los visitantes deben beber solo agua embotellada.
health.quote: There are no potable or clean water sources in Equatorial Guinea. Visitors should drink only bottled water.

health.en: Malaria is described as a leading cause of death in the country.
health.es: Se describe la malaria como una de las principales causas de muerte en el país.
health.quote: Malaria is a leading cause of death in this country.

health.en: The Marburg virus outbreak was declared over in June 2023 and no new cases have been reported.
health.es: El brote del virus de Marburgo se declaró terminado en junio de 2023 y no se han notificado nuevos casos.
health.quote: In June 2023, the outbreak of Marburg virus disease was declared over by the World Health Organisation (WHO) and the Equatorial Guinea government. No new cases have been reported.

health.en: Pharmacies in Malabo and Bata stock basic medication.
health.es: Las farmacias de Malabo y Bata tienen medicamentos básicos.
health.quote: Pharmacies in Malabo and Bata stock basic medication.

help.en: The ambulance number is 3101 and the police numbers are 666 404040 or 666 303030.
help.es: El número de ambulancias es el 3101 y los de la policía son 666 404040 o 666 303030.

help.en: Emergency numbers and emergency response are unreliable.
help.es: Los números de emergencia y la respuesta de emergencia no son fiables.
help.quote: Emergency numbers and emergency response are unreliable.

help.en: FCDO in London can be called 24 hours a day on 020 7008 5000 if something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Se puede llamar al FCDO en Londres las 24 horas al 020 7008 5000 si le ha ocurrido algo a un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.
help.quote:
You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.

Telephone: 020 7008 5000 (24 hours)

getting_in.en: The main international point of entry is Malabo airport.
getting_in.es: El principal punto de entrada internacional es el aeropuerto de Malabo.
getting_in.quote: The main international point of entry is Malabo (SSG IATA).

getting_in.en: Bata airport also hosts a few flights to neighboring countries.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Bata también recibe algunos vuelos a países vecinos.
getting_in.quote: Bata (BSG IATA) also hosts a few flights to neighboring countries.

getting_in.en: A ferry runs between Tiko near Douala, Cameroon and Malabo on an irregular schedule, roughly once a month.
getting_in.es: Un ferri une Tiko, cerca de Douala (Camerún), con Malabo en horario irregular, aproximadamente una vez al mes.
getting_in.quote: Viteoca operates a ferry service between the port of Tiko near Douala, Cameroon and Malabo. Services run on an irregular schedule, roughly once a month or so.

getting_in.en: Informal pirogue speedboat services run from Cogo to Cocobeach, Gabon.
getting_in.es: Hay servicios informales de piraguas rápidas de Cogo a Cocobeach, en Gabón.
getting_in.quote: There are also informal pirogue (speedboat) services from Cogo (at the southern tip of Rio Muni) to Cocobeach, Gabon.

getting_in.en: Malabo is on Bioko and not reachable by car, but the mainland can be reached from Gabon and Cameroon via roads.
getting_in.es: Malabo está en Bioko y no es accesible en coche, pero se puede llegar al continente por carretera desde Gabón y Camerún.
getting_in.quote: Malabo is on Bioko and not accessible by car, but the mainland may be accessed from Gabon via paved roads and from Cameroon.

getting_in.en: The entry from Campo is often closed, and Kye-Ossi and Ebebiyin may deny entry without sufficient reason.
getting_in.es: La entrada por Campo suele estar cerrada, y Kye-Ossi y Ebebiyin pueden denegar la entrada si no se presenta motivo suficiente.
getting_in.quote: The entry from Campo is often closed. Also, Kye-Ossi and Ebebiyin may deny entry if sufficient reason for entry is not presented or if you are not ethnically Caucasian.

getting_around.en: Most major roads on Bioko Island and the mainland are paved, though roads in some isolated rural areas are likely to be poor.
getting_around.es: La mayoría de las carreteras principales de Bioko y del continente están asfaltadas, aunque en algunas zonas rurales aisladas es probable que estén en mal estado.
getting_around.quote: Most major roads on Bioko Island and the Rio Muni mainland are now paved. In some isolated rural areas the condition of the roads is likely to be poor.

getting_around.en: Public transport facilities, particularly on the mainland, are extremely limited.
getting_around.es: El transporte público, en particular en el continente, es extremadamente limitado.
getting_around.quote: Public transport facilities, particularly on the mainland, are extremely limited.

money.en: The currency is the Central African CFA franc (FCFA, code XAF).
money.es: La moneda es el franco CFA de África Central (FCFA, código XAF).
money.quote: The currency is the Central African CFA franc, denoted FCFA (ISO currency code: XAF).

money.en: Mastercard or Visa cards can be used to withdraw money at any Ecobank ATM.
money.es: Se puede retirar dinero con tarjetas Mastercard o Visa en cualquier cajero Ecobank.
money.quote: You can withdraw money with a Mastercard or Visa card at any Ecobank ATM in Equatorial Guinea.

money.en: Credit cards can only be used at a few major hotels, including the Hilton and Sofitel.
money.es: Solo se puede pagar con tarjeta de crédito en unos pocos hoteles importantes, entre ellos el Hilton y el Sofitel.
money.quote: You can only pay by credit card at a few major hotels including the Hilton and Sofitel.

money.en: Local banks will exchange cash euros, British pounds and US dollars.
money.es: Los bancos locales cambian euros, libras esterlinas y dólares estadounidenses en efectivo.
money.quote: Local banks will exchange cash euros, British pounds and US dollars.

money.en: A decent room with very limited amenities is said to cost €100-400.
money.es: Se indica que una habitación decente con comodidades muy limitadas cuesta entre 100 y 400 €.
money.quote: A decent room with very limited amenities (bring necessities such as towels, soap and shampoo as the hotel may not have any) will be €100-400.

money.en: A simple lunch in a clean, air-conditioned restaurant is said to cost at least €30 without drinks.
money.es: Se indica que un almuerzo sencillo en un restaurante limpio y con aire acondicionado cuesta al menos 30 € sin bebidas.
money.quote: A simple lunch will cost at least €30 (without drinks such as wine, beer or soft drinks) in a clean, air-conditioned restaurant.

etiquette.en: Local people are described as very hospitable and familiar with everything related to Spain.
etiquette.es: Se describe a la población local como muy hospitalaria y familiarizada con todo lo relacionado con España.
etiquette.quote: Local people are very hospitable and have a certain familiarity for everything related to Spain

etiquette.en: Showing affection in public may attract unwanted and negative attention.
etiquette.es: Mostrar afecto en público puede atraer atención no deseada y negativa.
etiquette.quote: Showing affection in public may attract unwanted and negative attention. It is uncommon for opposite or same-sex couples to show affection in public.

etiquette.en: It is described as unwise to criticise or show disrespect to President Obiang or the government.
etiquette.es: Se describe como imprudente criticar o faltar al respeto al presidente Obiang o al gobierno.
etiquette.quote: It is unwise to criticise or show any kind of disrespect to Teodoro Obiang or the Equatoguinean government.

connectivity.en: The country code is +240 and the international call prefix is 00.
connectivity.es: El prefijo del país es +240 y el prefijo de llamadas internacionales es 00.
connectivity.quote: The country code is +240. The international call prefix is 00
